setup.title: Welcome
setup.subtitle: Two quick steps and your tunnels will take care of themselves.
setup.tokenIntro: Create an API token in Cloudflare with the permissions below, then paste it here. You only do this once.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Manage the tunnels running on this host.

dashboard.title: Tunnels
dashboard.subtitle: Tunnels running on this host keep themselves connected, even when this page is closed.

dashboard.name: Name

tunnel.deleteDescription: This removes the tunnel from Cloudflare, its public hostnames, the DNS records created here and the local service. This cannot be undone.
tunnel.metricsEmpty: Metrics appear after a couple of minutes.
tunnel.keepAliveHint: Restart the tunnel automatically when it stays unhealthy.
tunnel.toleranceHint: How long the tunnel may stay unhealthy before a restart.
tunnel.failingBanner: The watchdog gave up after several restarts. Check the logs, then start the tunnel again.
tunnel.ghost: This tunnel was deleted in Cloudflare. Delete it here to clean up.
tunnel.notHereBanner: This tunnel exists in your account but does not run on this host.
tunnel.localConfigBanner: This tunnel uses a local config file and can only be viewed.

routes.emptyHint: Publish a service from your network under one of your domains.
routes.conflictDescription: {{hostnames}} already point somewhere else. Replace with a record pointing to this tunnel?
routes.removeDescription: Traffic to this hostname will stop reaching your service.
routes.invalid: Check the hostname and service URL.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Account, security and maintenance.
settings.backupHint: Contains tunnel settings and DNS ownership. The Cloudflare token is never exported.
settings.imageUpdateHint: cloudflared is bundled in the Docker image and updated with each new image release. Pull the latest image and recreate the container to get it.
